_comment: Windows: merge into your user settings at C:/Users/<you>/.claude/settings.json. REPLACE <you> below with your Windows username - %USERPROFILE% and ~ are NOT expanded inside a hook command, and a hook whose path does not resolve fails silently. Forward slashes are deliberate: PowerShell accepts them, and a single backslash in JSON is an escape character that would eat the separator (C:\Users becomes C:Users). Adjust the path if the vault is not at C:/Users/<you>/skills-vault.
